text:
Elaine K.: Hi all 
I handed in my resignation this morning. Last day will be 2025-04-30. A couple of things I need clarity on: Im on the US medical plan but living in the UK, I have a pension transfer question, RSUs show a small vest on 2025-05-10, and Im away the week after my last day  how will final pay/benefits and device return work?
Jo (People Ops): Sorry to see you go, Elaine. Quick answers: BenefitAdmin sends the COBRA election notice by mail and usually an email copy; the 60-day election window starts from the mailed notice date. We can request the email copy go to your company email and update the mailing address to your UK home if needed. Final pay (pro-rated salary + untaken statutory holiday per UK rules if on local contract) processes on the next payroll after termination.
Elaine K.: Can you confirm whether COBRA applies if my permanent address is outside the US? My partner needs to arrange interim coverage.
CompAdmin: COBRA is a US plan continuation right; if your coverage is US-based we'll still issue notices. Because you're abroad, BenefitAdmin will typically email and mail; election timing still counts from the mailed notice date. We'll DM BenefitAdmin to request expedited email and confirm the mailing address.
Sophie (Payroll): For final salary: if you're on UK payroll, we pay holiday in lieu per local law on the final run. Deductions for commuter or pre-tax plans stop with the last check that covers the termination date. If you have expense reimbursements pending, flag them today so we can include them.
Marco - IT: For devices: we can provide a UK prepaid label or arrange office drop-off in our London partner hub. Please do not factory-reset; remove personal data if you want, then ship. We normally schedule SSO disable EOD on the last day (18:00 UTC) and revoke GitHub/CI tokens the following morning (07:00 UTC) to allow final handover. Want different timing because of travel?
Elaine K.: Yes please keep GitHub tokens alive until 09:00 UTC the morning after last day so I can finish a small migration job before I leave town. SSO disable at EOD is fine. Also, RSU cliff is 2025-05-10  will leaving on 4/30 prevent that vest?
CompAdmin: Vesting follows the grant. Generally you must be employed on the vest date to receive it. I'll review your grant and send a direct note within 2 business days with definitive treatment.
Ben (Manager): I'll take ownership of the runbooks and on-call. Elaine, please schedule a 90-min KT before 4/30 and tag me on the runbook pages. I'll take the PagerDuty ownership transfer on 4/29.
Elaine K.: I'll block 4/28 10:00-11:30 BST for KT and update PR owners. Also, mailbox and calendar  can mail be forwarded to Ben for 30 days and calendar remain visible to the team for 14 days?
Jo (People Ops): Yes to both. We'll set mailbox forwarding to Ben for 30 days and keep calendar visibility for 14 days. We'll also send the short exit questionnaire and a scheduler for a 30-min exit interview. Preferred morning slots next week?
Elaine K.: Morning next week works. One last oddball: I added a cloud bill to the company card for a short-term test project  who should I transfer billing to?
Marco - IT: Add the vendor & billing contact to the offboard ticket and tag IT Billing. We'll transfer the subscription and update the payment method before you leave.

Jo (People Ops): Thanks Elaine  we'll follow up on the grant/comp confirm and DM you the COBRA mailing update. Please paste the device tracking number in ticket OB-2025-358 when you drop it off. If anything urgent, ping @jo. :thumbsup:
